d: PV Sindhu is showing that 31 is far from the end of the road. After winning the Japan Open in July and the HYLO Open in Germany, the two-time Olympic medallist has put together an encouraging run ahead of the road to LA 2028. But Sindhu's latest chapter is about more than badminton titles and an Olympic comeback. From dealing with injuries and changing her training and recovery methods to questioning the Sports Authority of India's (SAI) decision to stop funding badminton, the Indian shuttler has plenty to say about the sport's future. Can Sindhu reinvent herself once again and make it to…
